dct_title_s: Zuidkust Celebes en Westzijde der Golf van Boni van Tg. Laso tot Tg. Polo
dct_description_sm: Hr. Ms. Opn. vtgn. "Banda," 1895, "Bali" 1901-1904 en "Sumbawa," 1918 ; Uitgegeven in Jani. 1923 door het Ministerie van Marine. Afdeeling Hydrographie.
Depths shown by soundings; relief by hachures and spot heights.
Second chart is continuation of first.
Shows depths, shoals, reefs, drainage, islands, peaks.
Stanford copy has handwritten navigational lines and notes to 1930.
